ABS Record Only Comment : Engine Power Limitation (EPL) approved, limiting the main engine’s power and speed to 32300kW and 89 rpm.

ABS Record Only Comment : At the request of the Owners, side-shell indentation at the vessel’s port quarter was inspected and reported as follows:

- 
Side-shell plating (Steering Gear Compartment) below the 2nd deck, between Side-Shell Longitudinal (SL) No. 6 and No. 7 and between Fr. -3 and Fr. -4 was found indented with a set-in depth of approximately 25mm.

- 
The indentation surface was noted to be smooth; no fractures and buckling of the internal stiffeners/support structures were noted. 

- 
The above were inspected and found to be satisfactory; no repairs were deemed necessary at this time.

Aforementioned was recorded as a Record Only comment in the vessel’s survey status.
